text:
maria: Heads up — NovaHealth wants a staged POC next week. Requirements: temporary +30% burst on their dedicated pool during east-coast demo hours (11:00-19:00 ET weekdays), a soft-priority queue that prefers demo requests but won't starve prod, scoped demo API keys with auto-rotation, and a private endpoint option. They also asked for an estimate of incremental cost and a hard stop if spend hits threshold. Any quick blockers?
sam: Which pool and baseline? Do they expect long sequences or many concurrent short chats? Also confirm if logs must be encrypted with their KMS.
maria: Pool is dp-nova-09 (baseline 16 GPUs). Workload: a mix — many short chats (~200 tokens) and occasional long transcripts (~2k). Peak concurrent sessions ~6. KMS required. No committed reserved capacity, ephemeral only.
lina: We can do soft-priority by giving demo traffic higher queue weight and a backpressure policy that drops to best-effort if tokens/backlog grows. Need the header or API key pattern to identify demo traffic.
tara: For keys I can create scoped demo keys with an expiry and rotation script. Will need the team list for access. I'll also add rate-limits per key to protect infra.
maria: Great. Use header `x-demo-client: nova` and demo keys prefixed with `demo-nova-`.
sam: Pricing estimate: burst billed at on-demand * 1.2. Rough ballpark for 2 weeks at expected pattern ~ $2,700 extra. If you want a firm calc I'll run the usage model. Finance: need approval for caps above $1,500.
finance: FYI — if they want a hard stop, we can set automatic throttling + notification at threshold, but hard shutdown needs explicit ops consent. We can approve $3,000 pre-validated cap for quick signoff.
maria: Ok we'll propose $3,000 cap to customer with alerts at $2,000. Can ops implement a throttle at cap instead of hard shutdown?
lina: Yes — throttle + alert is safer. I'll create a queue policy that limits burst concurrency when spend estimate nears cap.
tara: Demo key plan: expire keys at 14 days, rotate daily, link to audit logs (KMS). I'll push script to the sales repo.
sam: Autoscale suggestion (to apply to dp-nova-09):
```yaml
pool_id: dp-nova-09
baseline: 16
burst:
  enabled: true
  add_percent: 30
  schedule: "11:00-19:00" # ET weekdays
  max_instances: 22
queue_policy:
  demo_weight: 2
  default_weight: 1
  backpressure_threshold: 0.8 # fraction of token buffer
identification:
  header: "x-demo-client"
  value: "nova"
kms_encrypted: true
key_retention_days: "90"
```
ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-4312 to provision private endpoint, keys, and autoscale change. Assigned to @lina and @tara. ETA: private endpoint same-day if no network peering required, otherwise peering ~72h.
maria: Can we schedule a short smoke test Fri 12:30 ET? Need infra on the call to validate queue behavior and key rotation.
lina: I can join. tara: I can too, will bring the rotation script. sam: I'll post a cost breakdown to the ticket after we ingest historical token rate assumptions.
ops-bot: OPS-4312 updated with scheduled smoke test Fri 12:30 ET.
maria: Perfect. I'll update the customer with the proposed $3k cap and test slot. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
